ap_statistics-f01.title: A stratified sample survey of residents at a city

stimulus.description: Counts of survey answers by group in an earlier survey at a city.

data.notes: Answers to the question "Do you favor building a new library branch?" in an earlier survey of random samples from each group.

parts.label: A
parts.prompt: A researcher at a city plans a new survey and wants to select a stratified random sample of $100$ residents, with $50$ from each of two groups: renters and homeowners. Describe how the researcher could select such a sample.
parts.model_answer: Make a separate list of the renters and a separate list of the homeowners. Within each list, use a random number generator (or draw names at random) to select $50$ different residents; the two selections together form the stratified random sample.

rubric_rows.criterion: Separates the residents into the two groups (renters and homeowners) before selecting, with $50$ from each group
required_elements: separate lists for renters and homeowners

common_errors: selects 100 from all residents together

rubric_rows.criterion: Uses a chance method (random numbers or drawing names) within each group to choose the individuals, without repeats
